limitations: The dependency-free witness validates production source connections only. It does not infer computed contrast, browser focus order, focus trapping, accessible names, or motion behavior from source text; those behaviors belong to the browser and focused unit gates.

The browser gate uses Playwright-managed Chromium and Axe on the route states and modal surfaces it explicitly exercises. It does not claim physical-device, operating-system screen-reader, other-browser-engine, or deployed reverse-proxy parity.

Automated Axe checks cannot prove complete conformance or substitute for assistive-technology and manual usability review. Only serious and critical violations are blocking; lower-impact findings are outside this gate's acceptance threshold. The evidence is limited to the configured rules, rendered fixtures, viewports, and interaction paths.

Reduced-motion evidence covers CSS media-query behavior and the exercised chart interactions. It does not assert an operating-system preference outside Chromium emulation or animation code that is not reached by the gate.
WEB-09 retains final visual-fidelity and neutral-branding sign-off. WEB-08 verifies executable accessibility boundaries without claiming that later visual acceptance.
